events.title: After a year in Spain with 레알 소시에다드 , former 셰필드 웬즈데이 striker Dalian Atkinson returns to England in a £1.6million move to 애스턴 빌라 . Mike Milligan ends his year-long spell at 에버턴 and returns to 올덤 애슬레틱 for £600,000.
첼시 pay 셀틱 £1.4million for defender Paul Elliott .
리즈 유나이티드 sign striker Rod Wallace from 사우샘프턴 for £1.6million and defender Tony Dorigo from 첼시 for £1.3million.

Lennie Lawrence ends nine years as manager of 찰턴 애슬레틱 to become the new manager of 미들즈브러 in place of Colin Todd . Charlton in turn announce that coaches Alan Curbishley and Steve Gritt will replace Lawrence as a co-managerial team. 에버턴 striker 그레엄 샤프 ends 11 years at the club to sign for 올덤 애슬레틱 in a £500,000 deal, with Paul Warhurst heading out of Boundary Park in a £750,000 move to 셰필드 웬즈데이.
Former 리버풀 striker John Aldridge returns to England in a £250,000 move to 트랜미어 로버스 , becoming their record signing after spending two years in Spain with 레알 소시에다드.

Ron Atkinson looks to the future when he signs 18-year-old defender Ugo Ehiogu for 애스턴 빌라 from 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 for £40,000. Former 토트넘 홋스퍼 manager Peter Shreeves leaves 왓퍼드 to return to White Hart Lane as a coach, having worked at Vicarage Road on the coaching staff of former 토트넘 홋스퍼 player 스티브 페리먼 .
Mark Wright moves from 더비 카운티 to 리버풀 for £2.2million. Denmark goalkeeper 페테르 슈마이켈 joins 맨체스터 유나이티드 for £550,000.
리버풀 break the national transfer record by paying 더비 카운티 £2.9million for striker Dean Saunders .
애스턴 빌라 sell 데이비드 플래트 to A.S. Bari of Italy for £6.5million – the most expensive fee for a British player, and more than double the latest record paid by a British club.

노팅엄 포리스트 pay a club record £2million for 밀월 striker 테디 셰링엄 , who was the Football League 's top goalscorer last season. Amstrad computer tycoon Alan Sugar joins forces with 토트넘 홋스퍼 manager 테리 베너블스 to take the club over; Venables becomes chief executive and hands over management of the first team to Peter Shreeves, who only returned to the club as a coach eleven days ago.

37-year-old midfielder Jimmy Case moves from 사우샘프턴 on a free transfer to 본머스 , who sell defender Shaun Teale to 애스턴 빌라 for £300,000. Second Division 미들즈브러 sign striker Paul Wilkinson from 왓퍼드 for £500,000.
Joe Royle further boosts 올덤 애슬레틱's squad, ready for their first top flight season in almost 70 years, with a £400,000 move for 코번트리 시티 captain Brian Kilcline .
The Football Association wins High Court approval, ahead of the Football League, to launch the new Premier League from next season.
코번트리 시티 pay £130,000 for 22-year-old striker Paul Furlong from Isthmian League side Enfield .
